name: testify
description_en: A toolkit with common assertions and mocks that plays nicely with the standard library
readme_excerpt: Testify - Thou Shalt Write Tests > [!NOTE] > Testify is being maintained at v1, no breaking changes will be accepted in this repo. > See discussion about v2. Go code (golang) set of packages that provide many tools for testifying that your code will behave as you intend. Features include: Easy assertions Mocking Testing suite interfaces and functions Get started: Install testify with one line of code, or update it with another For an introduction to writing test code in Go, see https://go.dev/d…
